включить.gloss: to turn on, to plug in

meanings.en: to switch on, to plug in

meanings.note: Prefix 'во-' ('into, up') marks inward or upward movement (stem 'зрождаться'). Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'is reborn / revives'.

examples.text: Надо всё сделать и возрождаться вовремя.
examples.trans: We need to do everything and is reborn on time.

meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'вященный'). Adjective formed with the common Slavic suffix '-н-' from a noun/verb root. Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('sacred, holy').
